items.title: Realty Income (O) Gets An A Rating From Fitch And Joins A Small REIT Club
items.summary: Fitch Ratings has assigned Realty Income (NYSE:O) an A credit rating. This rating makes Realty Income the first net lease REIT and the fourth U.S. REIT overall with at least one A or equivalent rating from major agencies. The move reflects Fitch’s view of the company’s financial strength, portfolio diversification, and access to capital.
